tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal chen mo'i mdos chog bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rang bzhin gnas dang ye shes dang*// 'jig rten las grub ma mo ni// dpal ldan dud sol lha tshogs la// phyag byas de bskang mdos chog bri// 'bru sna'i ngar phye ri rab ni// bang rim gsum pa gling lcags ri// thod ril gsum bzhag rtser bum pa// ye shes rje sman bstan mar bcas// rgyan glang rngon cha spyan gzigs bkod// 'khor lo tog dang bcas pas brgyan// zhib pa mgon po'i mdos bshad bzhin// lha grangs khor yug rigs bsdus pa// de nas lha yi nga rgyal gyis// spyan 'dren 'di skad bya ba yin// hūm̐ ye rdzogs chen po gdangs kyi mdangs// rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'i mkha'/ ye grol chen po gshis kyi gshis// mchog tu 'gyur med bde ba'i gsang*// mkha' gsang mnyam par sbyar ba nas// rang bzhin ma mo spyan 'dren gyis// zung 'jug chen pos gshegs su gsol// byang chub phyogs kyi rang bzhin ni// sum cu rtsa bdun gzhal med khang*// rnam thar sgo gsum mdzes pa nas// ye shes ma mo spyan 'dren gyis// sgyu 'phrul chen po 'gro ba'i ma// kun 'gro tshul gyis gshegs su gsol// skye dgu'i las kyi snang ba yi// stong gsum chen po mi mjed zhing*// bskal bzang sgron ma 'bar ba nas// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā li ma// srid pa'i bdag mo chen mo khyod// gsang ba'i mtshan nas bos lags na// 'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol ma// 'khor du rje mo sman mo'i tshogs// sangs rgyas thugs rje sprul pa'i sku// gdug pa 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal can// gshegs shig bu yi gnas 'dir gshegs// gsur chen spos kyis bshul mtshon cing*// dar nag ldan pa'i hasta g.yabs// snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mos sbran// gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab kyis// myur ba nyid du gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas 'di ru// gdug pa ma lus tshar gcod pa'i// dmag dpon chen po bzhugs nas kyang*// mdos dang glud 'di bzhes su gsol//

mtshang 'dru dam la bzhag pa ni/ hūm̐ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka /nga ni za byed chen po ste// phyag na rdo rje hūm̐ ka ra// 'jigs byed rdo rje 'jigs byed do// nga ma gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas med// thams cad nga yi dam la gnas// srid pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro ma// kun gyi snying khrag nga la yod// nga yis las bcol khyod kyis sgrubs// gal te g.yel nas las 'gyangs na// bka' log dam 'god dmyal bar sreg /oṃ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags drug phyag ting 'dzin gyis// so so'i yid bzhin gyin gyis brlab// rang rang dga' ba de ngor bkod// kye srid pa'i bdag mo 'khor bcas la// rin chen gser skyems 'di 'bul gyis// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong ldan pa'i// bdud rtsi sman gyi dza gad bzhes// mdos sna glud kyis 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ rin chen ngar gyi mi bo che// zer spu yid 'ong mgo bo'i skra// lung thang mig la 'gron bu'i so// byi ru'i lce la mtshal gyi khrag /zho sha'i snying la dung gi rus// tsan dan dri la 'bru yi sha /rkang g.yas lcags la g.yon pa zangs// ske la nor bu gos bzang gyon// rgyab tu gtan gyi dkor nor khur// mdun du lo brgyags bzang po khyongs// 'byung ba rnams bzhi'i dwangs mas bsgrubs// phung khams skye mched gtsang la dod// bdag cag khyed la 'bul lo zer// dga' ba'i 'dzum chen mu lu lu// de 'dra'i glud chen dam pa 'bul// mdos bdag chen po mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag chen po glud bzhes shig/ de nas mdos bsngo 'di yin te/ kye srid pa'i ma mo 'dul ba la// khrag 'thung chen mo bzhengs pa'i sku// dang por dung skyong u ma'i sras// phyis nas srin gzugs gshin rje'i lcam// ma mo chen mo mi gzan ma// dbu la khrag gi ral pa 'thibs// ral pa bsigs pa'i skra gseb nas// khrag gi ma stong sha ra ra// nad kyi na bun thu lu lu// rdo rje'i thog ser nyi li li// khros pa'i kha rlangs stong gsum gang*// tsha ba'i me phung 'u ru ru// rno ba'i mtshon ma zing nge nge*// zhal du khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil// gdug pa'i ro tshogs long long po// spyan gsum gzir ba'i gzi brjid ngar// nyi ma 'bum phrag shar ba bzhin// dgra bgegs gzhob ltar 'thul lu lu// phyag g.yas ral gri glad la skor// ma rungs gdug pa'i brgyud gcod ma// 'og ma bhañdza khrag rgyun can// lha min snying rtsa nas 'thung ma// g.yon pa shakti rtse gsum gyis// bdud bsad mgo bo ga shar 'phyang*// smug nag nu ma rting par drud// dur khrod chas brgyad 'chang ba mo// he ru ka yi gzung ma che// khyod kyis mi thub su yang med// steng gi lha chen dbang phyug kyang*// 'dod chags chen pos khyod dbang gyur// dgu khri dgu stong rgyal po ste// u ma de wi nyid ka lags// de phyir khyod ming bka' bzlog ma// bar gyi tshangs pas phyag byas pas// khyod la srid pa'i rgyal mor gsol// dga' rab dbang phyug dang mdza' bas// bdud yum 'dod pa'i dbang mor thogs// dbang po nye dbang lha yi dmag

/pham dus khyod kyi lto bar bcug /lha min btul bas rdzong mor grags// ri rab che dang sku bsdur bas// nyi zla lte ba'i dbus nas shar// rgyal chen sde bzhis phyag byas pa// lha mo chen mo dpal ldan ma// rgya mtsho'i klong du me 'bar bas// klu dbang thams cad khyod gsung nyan// sa 'og rim dgur khyod gshegs nas// chos kyi rgyal po'i lcam du byas// chibs su bong bu gwa dmar bcibs// bang ni yid dang glog bas mgyogs// skad cig nyid la khams gsum 'khor// zas su mi sha mi khrag skom// nad kyi bdag la bdud rtsi'i bdag /mdos bdag chen mo mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag chen mo glud long zhig /nyi zla stong gi thod 'phreng can// chags byed cha snyom gcer bu gsum// phung byed sbas pa'i ma mo bzhi// re ti mched bzhir 'jig rten grags// rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'o// khros pa'i ma mo bzhi dang ni// gsang ba rgyan gyi rgyal mo bzhi// phra med gdong can brgyad po ste// srid pa'i ma mo khyed rnams kyang*// mdos bdag lags kyis mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag lags kyis glud bzhes shig /srid pa'i sman mo chen po brgyad// dmag gi rgyal mo chen mo bzhi// gru 'degs dpal gyi ma mo bzhi// las kyi ma mo chen mo bzhi// za bar byed pa'i srin mo bdun// yang gab ma mo chen mo bzhi// dbang byed las kyi ma mo bzhi// gza' bdud mar gyur gdong mo bzhi// dur khrod ru kha ma mo gsum// srid gsum phung byed ma mo gsum// gsang ba'i ma dang pho nya gsum// ma mo kun gyi g.yog mo gsum// pho nya bzhi dang sprul pa bzhi// bla 'gugs bzhi dang tshe 'phrog bzhi// gzer 'debs bzhi dang ma mo'i tshogs// lha chen chung ma nyi shu brgyad// gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms mkha' 'gro ma// sum cu rtsa gnyis bcas pa dang*// las kyi shugs 'gro bcu gnyis dang*// sbas pa'i bu mo thal mdog ma// gnod pa'i snying 'dren 'bar ma brgyad// sa yi bdag mo sum cu gnyis// pho nya chen mo drug cu bzhi// 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// ladga ma ni bcu drug dang*// nam gru chen mo dgu dang ni// dkar mo glog gi sham bu can// ser mo nyi ma'i snang ba can/

khra mo thog gi bu yug can// nag mo mun pa'i ral pa can// dmar mo zangs kyi mche ba can// smug mo lcags kyi sbar ba can// sngon mo bse yi lan phran can// ljang nag g.yu yi go zu can// re re'ang 'bum phrag sder chad pa// yang sprul las byed gshan pa mo// dbugs la 'jab pa'i dbang mo che// bla srog 'phrog pa'i mthu mo che// las kyi tshe 'phrog chu srin mgo /gti mug khros pa'i ru sbal mgo /sna tshogs gdong dang lag mang po// las kyi so myul rdzu 'phrul can// gling bzhi bskor zhing sems can gsod// 'ja' tshon slag pa sku la gsol// g.yang gzhi sna tshogs phrag par bkal// nad kyi bdag la rims kyi rkyen// snang srid ma mo 'khor bcas rnams// mdos bdag lags kyis mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag lags kyis glud bzhes shig /'dzam bu gling gi 'jig rten la// dbang bsgyur ma mo chen mo ni// mi bzad dur bya kaṅka'i gdong*// las byed sgo ma chen mo bzhi// rgya mtsho'i gting du zhabs brkyang pas// ri rab pang du 'degs byed ma// bar snang khams su phyag brkyang nas// nyi zla gza' skar 'khrug byed ma// dbu skra sprin nag gtibs pa bzhin// spyan gsum glog 'od me ri 'bar// khyed kyi bka' nyan sring gi tshogs// phung sri nag mo mgo dgu ma// nyal na lung gsum mdo 'gags ma// langs na ri gsum rtse khyab ma// nag mo ral ring bya gdong can// srog bdag nag mo khrag mdog ma// brag srin pho mo'i 'khor dang bcas// dur srin phag thod gos slag can// phag zhon phung sri dur sris bskor// thab phung g.yag thul g.yag la zhon// thab srin gzhob srin 'khor gyis bskor// chu mig lo ma sngo bdag mo// mdzo mo la zhon men sri'i gos// sbrul dang sbal pa'i cha ga can// chung sri pho mo'i 'khor gyis bskor// brag phug bdag mo nya lcibs gos// rtol zhon sa srin chu srin 'khor// shing phug stong pa'i mnga' bdag mo// ral pa'i gseb nas me 'bar ma// phag pa mgo gsum rta ru zhon// rnal 'byor kun gyi dam sri mo// brag phug dben gnas rnying pa'i bdag

/mi lpags gos gyon thod pa'i thod// bong bu gwa dmar rta ru zhon// phung sri nag mo 'khor dang bcas// dur sri nag mo'i phung sri mo// byi la khra bo'i rta zhon ma// ban bon kun gyi lto 'jig ma// de ltar sgo ma 'khor bcas kyang*// mdos bdag lags kyis mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag lags kyis glud bzhes shig /ro langs ma dang sha za mo// smyo byed ma dang grib gnon ma// phung byed ma dang drang srong ma// srin mo gshin rje chu lha mo// rlung lha mo dang gnod sbyin mo// dbang ldan mo dang dri za mo// grul bum mo dang lha min mo// lha mo mkha' lding mi'am ci// bstan ma srid pa sman mo'i tshogs// mdos bdag lags kyis mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag lags kyis glud long cig /hūm̐ 'jig rten khams la dbang sgyur ma// dar dkar shel dkar padma dang*// mthing ga'i gur gyi bdag mo bzhi// dus bzhir 'char ba'i ma mo ste// bgyis na lo legs skya rgyal zhing*// yul khams bde 'jam nad med pa// khros na btsa' than sad ser gyis// lo 'joms dus 'khrugs nad bshig gtong*// mdos bdag lags kyis mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag lags kyis glud long cig /ma khyed khro ba'i rgyu bshags kyis// gnod pa'i dug dbal ma spro zhig /yul 'dir bde skyid lo legs thong*// glang lpags bye ru g.yu dang ni// zhing chen gur gyi bdag mo bzhi// nad kyi bdag mo chen mo ste// mnyes na rlung rta dbang thang dang*// 'byung ba cha snyoms dpal bskyed la// khros na bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad// god lhog phyugs nad kun gtong la// mdos bdag lags kyis mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag lags kyis glud long cig /ma khyed khro ba'i rgyu bshags kyis// gnod pa'i dug dbal ma spro zhig /yul 'di'i mi phyugs nad sol zhig /gser dang bse dang re lde dang*// ljang nag gur gyi bdag mo bzhi// 'jig rten phung byed ma mo ste// mnyes na longs spyod dbang thang dang*// stobs dang tshe la dbang byed pa// khros na gdon ris ltas ngan pa// bgegs kun 'gyed cing khram la 'debs// mdos bdag lags kyis mdos bzhes shig

/glud bdag lags kyis glud long cig /ma khyed khro ba'i rgyu bshags kyis// gnod pa'i dug dbal ma spro zhig /yul 'dir bar chad med par skyongs// dbus gling 'od kyi gur bdag mo// srid pa'i ri rab khang brtsegs la// dpag bsam shing gi lding khang btab// shel rigs mang po'i rgyan dang ldan// de na srid pa'i bde 'gro ma// ma mo de bzhin gshegs pa ste// phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'chang*// 'gro ba kun gyi nad sel ma// bha gar 'byung ba lnga 'char ma// 'bru bcud dus su smin par mdzad// de phyir rtag pa'i ma gcig pu// mdos bdag chen mo mdos bzhes shig /glud bdag chen mo glud long cig /kun la byams rtse'i gnyen gcig pu// thams cad khyod kyi mkha' las phyung*// rang rang las kyi bka' bsgo nas// mi bzad duḥkha dag gis mnar// de la ma khyod gzigs par 'tshal// gnod pa'i skyon rnams da sol cig /nyes pa'i rtsa ba kun phyung zhig /bde skyid sa bon kun thob cig /bsam pa 'grub pa'i dmod bor cig/ snang srid gsil bu'i gyer bsdus pa/ hūm̐ rlung dang me dang chu dang sa// lhun po rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin// sna tshogs ri gling mtsho ldan pa// sa bla sa 'og sa steng gnas// mi mjed zhing khams ji lta ba// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// steng du 'phur ba'i 'dab chags khrom// char gyi sprin pa lta bur gtibs// bar na sa la rgyu ba'i 'gro// dog mo'i sa gzhi thams cad bkang*// chur gnas srog chags kun gyi rigs// rgya mtsho chen po 'phyur gyis gang*// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// lhag par dgyes pa'i dmar chen khrag /sha rus snying gi 'phreng ba dang*// 'bru sna kun gyi ba ling ta// dkar dmar rgyan gyis bkra ba rnams// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// shing gris mda' 'phang dag la ni// so so'i sku dang phyag mtshan bkod// sa bon yi ge gzugs su btab// dbang mtshan rdo rje rnam par bkod// bal ti shug ti dag gis brgyan// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// srid pa spyi bris yul gyi glud// pho gdong mo gdong dar ma dang*// rgyang bu byis pa'i glud rdzas te// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// mi 'gyur dbyings kyi nam mkha' la// ye shes lnga rdzogs mdangs su chags// mthun rdzas bya spu dar shog dpyangs// yungs mo'i rgyan mdzes 'chang ba 'di// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// 'bru sna bcu gsum dag dang ni// rin chen rnam lnga sman gyi sde// dar zab pags bu mar me dang*// spos sogs 'jig rten khams kyi nor// bzhed pa thams cad 'dir bsags pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas kyang*// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan dang*// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// dung dang rnga chen cha lang dang*// rnge'u chung dril bu cang te'u// bhañdza'i cha lang ltag sprod rnga// rkang chen gling bu dbyangs kyi sde// snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kun gyi// thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas su 'bul// hūm̐

da ni mdos la rdzongs shig 'debs// ye shes ma mo mkha' 'gro la// bdud rtsi sna lnga'i rdzongs shig 'debs// 'jig rten ma mo mkha' 'gro la// sha khrag rus pa'i rdzongs shig 'debs// las kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro la// dam nyams srog dbugs rdzongs shig 'debs// 'khor tshogs 'bum phrag yangs pa la// sga g.yer btsong dang zhun la sogs// lho rdzas rnams kyi rdzongs shig 'debs// ram bu rug pa ri sgog sogs// ri rdzas rnams kyi rdzongs shig 'debs// bra bo sne'u lo ma sogs// klungs rdzas rnams kyi rdzongs shig 'debs// gtsod dang lan tshwa la sogs pa// byang rdzas rnams kyi rdzogs shig 'debs// ba tshwa bul tog la sogs pa// g.yog mo'i tshogs la rdzongs su 'debs// hūm̐ dang po o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling*// srid pa'i rgyal mo khyod g.yos nas// snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre 'khrugs// rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti bsnyung*// yul khams ltas ngan cho 'phrul dang*// khrag 'khrugs nad rims phyugs nad dang*// mu ges skye dgu phal cher shi /de tshe dga' rab rdo rje yis// snang srid yas dang thags su bgyis// srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams la phul// srid pa'i rgyal mo'i thugs dam skongs// ma mo'i 'khor tshogs thams cad mnyes// mdos dang glud blangs so sor bzhud// gnod par gyur pa thams cad zhi// de bzhin bdag gis ma rnams bskang*// snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre mchod// de bas yul 'dir gnod ma mdzad// yas thags 'di snoms gnas su bzhud// dgyes pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// de nas bar du gdong dmar bod// rmongs pa'i 'gro la thugs rje nas// chos kyi rgyal po rim par 'ongs// lhag par khri srong lde btsan gyis// dam pa chos kyi srol rgyas phyir// gtsug lag khang chen phyag bris mdzad// mkhas pa'i paṇa lo ci yang bshams// dam pa chos rnams bsgyur zhugs tshe// nag phyogs lha 'dre g.yo thabs kyis// rgyal po bsnyung zhing rgyal khams mnar// sdig blon thams cad ngo mtho'i dus// slob dpon padma badzra gyis// rgyal po'i dkor nor kha zas la// yas thags bgyis te de la bsngos// rang rang yid thob mgu zhing tshim// gnod pa lta ci phan pa'i thabs// sgrub pa'i mngag gzhug nyid du zhugs// de bzhin da lta rnal 'byor ngas// rgyu sbyor yon rnams mdos su byas// sbyin bdag kun gyi glud du sbyar// sngags rgya ting 'dzin stobs kyis bsngos// dpal gyi lha mo chen mo nas// srid pa sman mo'i bar rnams kyi// 'jigs byed ma mo'i tshogs la phul// pho brgyud rnams kyang des skongs so//

mdos gzhug gnyis las skabs bzhin spyad/ hūm̐ da ni mdos 'gro shar ra ra// da ni glud 'gro cu ru ru// da ni ma mo'i khrom sgyur ro// lha 'dre'i za kha da sgyur ro// zlog sgyur byed pa'i mthu mo che// dgra dpung 'joms pa'i rtsal mo che// nad dal gcod pa'i dbang mo che// lha srin las 'khor shed mo che// khrom dang za kha dgra la sgyur// dgra mo khyed kyi zas skal gtad// gang la bya ba ma smos mkhyen// le lor ma bzhag yan ma gtang*// zhag dang za ma nyid du sgrol// ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig thong*// ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu sbyor// gdon chen thams cad de ru rdzongs// stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa'i// bgegs kyi dmag sgar de ru thob// dam sri spun dgu de ru rgyug /nad kyi rkyal ba de ru phye// mtshon gyi dru gu de ru rkyongs// btsan byang bris la bdud khram thob// nag po'i rde'u de ru thor// rgyan gzhi thing zhig ma mo'i tshogs// bskul sogs gtor ma bzhin du bya// gnyis pa slu ba rkyang pa sogs/ hūm̐ da ni mdos gtong mdos bdag bzhud// ye shes ma mo dbyings su gshegs// skye 'gag med pa'i don la spyod// las kyi ma mo byang shar bzhud// legs nyes kun gyi bya ra mdzod// ma yul byang shar pha gi na// mya ngan snam bu'i pha rol na// g.yu mtsho mu le'i nang shed na// bse mkhar smug po ldem se ldem// bse mkhar de yi nang shed na// thang shing sngon po'i gur phub pa// ma mo nyid kyi bzhugs gnas yin// mi yul skyin lding gtan yul min// ma cig de ru sku bskyod 'tshal// nad bdag thams cad de ru bzhud// gzhan rnams rang rang yul la gshegs// bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// nad kyi rkyal pa kha chings shig /mtshon gyi dru gu mtha' nas thul// khram byang phyis la sho kha dor// rde'u rgyan gzhi gnyis ka skums// ltas ngan cho 'phrul g.yang du khug

/gdon bgegs log 'dren srangs mar sgyur// ye 'drog shis pa'i rtags su bzos// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// rnal 'byor bsam pa'i las kun sgrubs// zhes brjod mnyam nyid ngang du bzhag /'di yang padma dkar po yis// byams pa chen po'i chos gling sbyar// ma rnams dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bcas// rtag tu bdag cag skyong gyur cig// / sarba swa ti bha wantu/// /
